finding_dispositions.note: I.31 was read at its locus (transcription line 36, col. 1329) and its Latin checked word for word on the PL 35 page image. It is recorded in scope 3.6 and bound, together with the PL 35 scan and the excerpt. Scope 4.3 now gives Augustine's own answer and records separately that Sermons 90 and 95 do not take up the point, and its closing sentence is corrected. Interpretations 2.1, 2.4, 2.5 and 2.6 (and 2.2 and 2.3) are revised, with Gregory's moral reading kept as the distinct answer. Every discover lead has a disposition in scope 3.13, and Rabanus on Ephesians and Rolle on Ps 104 are added to 5.3.

The only changes are audited_on, canonical_catalog_snapshot and snapshot, and the ledger has no families to review. Scope changes. 3.6 records I.31 with its route, state and page-image Latin. It also records II.30 on Lk 14:21 and 23 and Sermo 112 (NPNF Sermon LXII) on Luke's supper, marked as Luke and not transferred to Mt 22. Sermons 90 and 95 were re-searched whole, and the finding that they take up neither the refusers nor the highways is recorded separately. In 4.3, Augustine moves from 'No answer to the question' to his own bullet, and the closing sentence is corrected. 4.4 adds I.31's reading of the nuptials. 3.13 is new and gives every lead of the discover rerun (run with --max-results 100, no list truncated) its disposition. 5.3 adds Rabanus on Ephesians and Rolle on Ps 104, plus Alcuin, who was already in 3.9. 6, 9 and 10 add the PL 35 route and its rights. Interpretation changes. 2.1 names Augustine as a holder of the highways step and keeps the Alleluia join [S]. Augustine takes both steps, but in separate works. 2.5 says the form of his answer differs: the ways are the Gentiles' teachings, and in I.31 he names no refusers, so he may not be cited for Israel's refusal. Gregory's moral reading stays as the distinct answer. 2.6 and the section 5 author table are updated. The carrying authors are unchanged. Advisory RES-009 is cleared: the Jews-and-Gentiles clause is now cited to Jerome, the Incarnation union to Gregory section 3 and I.31, the apostolic preaching to Schuster, and the proclamation among the gentiles to Bellarmine. summary: Repaired RES-008. Augustine's Quaestiones evangeliorum I.31 was read in the tracked PL 35 transcription and checked word for word against a page image of PL 35 col. 1329. This stage registered PL 35 to get that page image. I.31 is now recorded and bound, and scope 4.3 and interpretations 2.1, 2.2, 2.3, 2.4, 2.5 and 2.6 give Augustine's own answer: the highways are dogmata Gentium, the teachings of the Gentiles. Every lead in the discover rerun now has a disposition, tabulated in scope 3.13.
